Preprocessing specified at a level that permits reproduction: 16 kHz monaural resampling with a Butterworth filter, 25 ms window, 10 ms hop, 400-point FFT, 60 MFCCs and Mel bins, 50 Hz articulatory traces and 100 Hz posteriorgrams, with the producing software named (b2aiprep, sparc, openSMILE, Parselmouth/Praat, ppgs, Whisper) and the principal repositories linked, licensed and in two cases Zenodo-archived.

Version and provenance tracking is complete: six releases with dates, per-version DOIs distinguished from the version-agnostic DOI, three specific errata including breaking changes, a stated semi-annual cadence borne out by the observed release history, and raw data sources traced to the systems that captured them.

Limitations and bias disclosure is unusually self-critical: four taxonomy-aligned bias types including a measurement bias that identifies a real confound between recording device and disease cohort, six typed limitations, and the reporting of the consortium's own AI-readiness criteria on which the dataset scores poorly.

Source conflicts are surfaced rather than smoothed: per-field caveats on collection timeframe, content warnings, compensation and confidential elements, plus a record-level caveat resolving the referent, participant and recording counts, five divergent grant renderings, consortium size, enrollment target and two investigator name spellings, each with the resolution rule stated.
weaknesses: Keywords are the one clear failure: four broad terms (health, biomarkers, bridge2ai, voice) that omit every disease cohort, every non-voice modality, every feature family and the BIDS standard, leaving the record poorly retrievable despite an otherwise rich description.

Variable-level metadata covers only the four Parquet index columns; the phenotype tables the record itself enumerates (confounders, demographics, diagnosis, enrollment, questionnaires, task metadata) have no entries and are delegated to JSON data dictionaries that are described but not individually cited.

Several dedicated schema slots are empty while their substance sits in prose elsewhere: publisher, download_url, is_tabular, imputation_protocols, was_derived_from, and media_type and encoding on the distribution formats. Human readers lose nothing; machine consumers and automated FAIR assessors do.

The collection timeframe is unresolved: a stated 12-month period sits against a four-year phased IRB protocol and a release history spanning November 2024 to May 2026, and the record flags the conflict without settling which window produced the v3.1.0 data.

Two regulatory statements overreach. The claim that no export controls 'or other regulatory restrictions' apply contradicts the HIPAA, Certificate of Confidentiality and PhysioNet obligations itemized in adjacent fields, and confidential_elements_present is set false despite the CoC recorded in the same block.

Processing software is named but largely unversioned: openSMILE, Praat, Parselmouth, sparc and ppgs carry no version numbers, so the feature extraction is reproducible in method but not pinned to specific implementations, which matters for acoustic features sensitive to library changes.
recommendations: Expand keywords to 8-12 terms drawn from the description and instances, covering the disease cohorts (voice disorders, neurodegenerative, psychiatric, respiratory), the modalities (speech, cough, breathing), the feature families (spectrogram, MFCC, phonetic posteriorgram) and the standards (BIDS, FHIR).

Populate the empty dedicated slots with values already present in prose: publisher as PhysioNet, is_tabular, media_type and encoding on each distribution format, imputation_protocols recording the no-imputation decision, and was_derived_from for the Health Data Nexus lineage; retain the prose, which is the more informative part.
Extend variables to the principal phenotype columns, or cite the shipped JSON data dictionaries by file path so they are dereferenceable from the datasheet rather than merely referred to.

Resolve the collection window by stating the first and last session dates for the v3.1.0 cohort and recording the four-year study period separately, so the 12-month figure is scoped rather than contradicted.

Narrow the 'no regulatory restrictions' statement to export controls specifically, and scope confidential_elements_present to the released feature set so it no longer conflicts with the Certificate of Confidentiality documented alongside it.

Pin versions for the processing stack (openSMILE, Praat, Parselmouth, sparc, ppgs, Whisper Large, b2aiprep) and cite the b2aiprep release or commit used to build v3.1.0, so the feature extraction is reproducible against specific implementations.

Record the per-feature recording counts as structured values on the audio recording instance, so the deliberate absence of a single recording total is visible in the data rather than only in source_caveats.
